newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council set to adopt posted workers directive.
newsitem.headline: Council set to adopt posted workers directive.

text.p: The Social Affairs Council is set to adopt the posted workers directive as an "A" (non-discussion) point on Tuesday, EU officials said.
The European Parliament last week approved the Council's common position without amendment.
The legislation, COM(93)225, will guarantee construction and other workers who are posted across borders the same pay and working conditions as those hired locally.
Governments may wait up to one month, however, to apply minimum pay rules -- or allow trade unions and employers to negotiate such a delay.
They may also exempt "small jobs" from rules on minimum wages and paid annual leave and wait up to eight days to apply the rules to assembly and installation work.
